name: Disable Smart Multi-Homed Name Resolution
description: Disables smart multi-homed name resolution to reduce parallel lookups across multiple network interfaces, which can improve stability on complex networks.

description_i18n.en: Disables smart multi-homed name resolution to reduce parallel lookups across multiple network interfaces, which can improve stability on complex networks.
description_i18n.de: Deaktiviert die intelligente Namensauflösung für mehrfache IP-Adressen, um parallele Suchvorgänge über mehrere Netzwerkschnittstellen zu reduzieren und die Stabilität auf komplexen Netzwerken zu verbessern.
description_i18n.fr: Désactive la résolution de noms multi-hôtes intelligente pour réduire les recherches parallèles sur plusieurs interfaces réseau et améliorer la stabilité des réseaux complexes.

warnings.title: required
warnings.message: This tweak requires an elevated administrator session to apply changes and modify network settings

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: This tweak modifies the registry key HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows NT\DNSClient by setting or removing the DisableSmartNameResolution DWORD value
